title: Null controllability on measurable sets for the complex cubic Ginzburg--Landau equation
summary: This paper investigates the null controllability of the complex cubic Ginzburg--Landau equation with controls supported on general space-time measurable sets. Starting from a positive-measure control set, we use a slicing argument to obtain time slices of uniformly positive spatial measure. This yields uniform spectral inequalities on the slices, which are the key ingredient in constructing quantitative stabilizing feedbacks.
